task: Assess whether the containment check still protects the file actually read.
facts: The handler runs as a service account and serves downloads.
A lower-privileged local tenant can rename /srv/exports/slot and replace it with a symlink after checked is set and before resume is signalled.
For relative=slot/secret, the original file passes containment.
The replacement link points to /srv/private, which contains a secret readable only by the service.
No other guard constrains the subsequent read.
